title: Dance Tonight! Revolution Tomorrow!
desc_lfm_album: Dance Tonight! Revolution Tomorrow! is the second studio album by Emoviolence band Orchid, released on December 4th, 2000 under Ebullition Records. Ebullition was known for signing early pioneers of Screamo and emoviolence, such as Portraits of Past and Reversal of Man. Dance Tonight! Revolution Tomorrow! was recorded at God City Studios in December of 1999, a studio that Converge guitarist Kurt Ballou established in 1998. The album shifts away from the raw, dark, and extreme Powerviolence derived sound orchid had previously established with their debut album Chaos Is Me and completely flips it over it's head. Chaos Is Me
desc_lfm_album: Chaos Is Me is the debut studio album by American emoviolence band Orchid. It was released in 1999 through Ebullition Records. Chaos Is Me heralded the change of the guard for extreme music, and brought both Amherst, Massachusetts and Hampshire College to the forefront of the scene's attention. The album was produced by Kurt Ballou at God City Studios in Spring 1999. .

title: The Moon Is a Dead World
desc_lfm_artist:
Gospel is an American post-hardcore band formed in Brooklyn, New York in 2003. The band comprises Adam Dooling, Sean Miller, Vincent Roseboom and Jon Pastir.  Their sound mixes the atmosphere of psychedelia, structural sensibilities and instrumentation of Genesis-esque progressive rock, and primal aggression/desperation of hardcore/screamo.

Their debut full-length on Level Plane was released on May 10, 2005, entitled The Moon Is a Dead World.

title: Is Survived By
desc_lfm_album: 'Is Survived By' is the third studio album by American post-hardcore band Touché Amoré. The album was released on September 24, 2013 through Deathwish Inc. The full track listing and artwork was revealed on July 17, 2013. The album's first single, "Just Exist", was released on July 30, 2013. .
desc_lfm_artist: Touché Amoré is an American post-hardcore band from Burbank, California, formed in 2007. The band consists of lead vocalist Jeremy Bolm, guitarists Clayton Stevens and Nick Steinhardt, with Tyler Kirby on bass guitar and drummer Elliot Babin. They have released five studio albums and several EPs. The band's debut ...To the Beat of a Dead Horse was released in 2009, followed by Parting the Sea Between Brightness and Me in 2011. On September 24, 2013, their third full length, Is Survived By was released.
